summary: Cedar policy-decision seam wiring for messenger, mail, social, and community API/usecase/REST boundaries.
claim_boundary: Policy decision references are now required and propagated as metadata at API/usecase/REST boundaries. This is not a Cedar evaluator, runtime policy adapter, full policy-set conformance suite, or production authorization claim.

facets.F1_simplicity: The seam adds string metadata and fail-closed validation only; no Cedar runtime dependency, framework binding, network I/O, or adapter coupling was introduced.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: Honest non-claim: authorization is not hyperscaler-grade until policy evaluation, audit-chain emission, runtime telemetry, and CI policy conformance evidence exist.
facets.F3_adversarial: Negative tests cover missing policy decisions and cross-context personal/work scope drift across API and REST boundaries.
facets.F5_quality: cargo test, clippy -D warnings, and cargo fmt --check pass for the 12 touched API/usecase/REST packages.
facets.F7_security_privacy: Requests fail closed when policy decision references are missing; personal context now rejects tenant scope in messenger, mail, and social boundaries.
facets.F11_observability: Receipts carry policy decision references alongside idempotency and audit correlation for future audit-chain/OTel correlation; no runtime emission claim.
